checks.name: Fresh SQLite migration is additive and idempotent; old sessions start with empty attachment facts
Concurrent repeated selection deduplicates a real captured source and preserves original bytes
Original Hana metadata and source identity capture real image bytes; public projection excludes private paths/hash and upload data
Same physical file has distinct session ownership; forged cross-session attachment IDs cannot be opened
Preview resolves a captured version and refuses changed files without rewriting historical metadata
Remove uses real revision CAS; old selection stays removed and explicit reselection creates a new attachment fact
Multi-attachment bind is atomic on stale selection; submitted message/run facts are immutable and repeat use gets a new reference
SQLite enforces per-session eight-draft limit independently of UI locks
Native filesystem rejects credential paths, linked ancestors/hardlinks, traversal, spoofed image, unsupported SVG and oversized text
Cancelled/current-owner and changed workspace lease create no attachment records
Strict revision selectors reject unknown keys/symbols and do not execute accessor input
Actual SQLite reopen preserves submitted/removed revisions and rejects unknown row schema without silent fallback
Explicit prior formal-test SQLite copy accepts repeated migration without changing messages, sessions, settings or native bindings

boundary: Real SQLite and native local filesystem; synthetic fixtures and explicit prior isolated test DB copy only. No chooser, production attachment IPC, model image upload, OCR or viewed-image receipt claim.
